auditFocus: a BuildContext used after an await with no context.mounted (or State.mounted) check first
a StatefulWidget with a TextEditingController/AnimationController/StreamSubscription/FocusNode created in initState but never released in dispose
setState called after an async gap with no mounted guard, risking 'setState() called after dispose()'
a widget tree many levels deep in one build method instead of extracted into smaller const-friendly widgets
a secret, token, or API key read from or written to SharedPreferences instead of flutter_secure_storage
a bang operator (!) on a nullable value with no preceding null check or non-null guarantee in scope
buildCommands: flutter build apk --debug (or the project's actual target platform build)
fixGuardrails: never add // ignore: or a blanket // ignore_for_file: comment to silence an analyzer finding instead of fixing the root cause
never add the bang operator (!) to a nullable value just to satisfy the analyzer without first establishing the value is actually non-null there
never delete or weaken a failing widget test's expectation (find.text/find.byType assertion) to make it pass
never pin or downgrade a pub dependency to route around a real incompatibility without saying so in the report
